title: Surreal Eye and Orb
description: A surreal composite artwork featuring a large realistic human eye in black and white on the right, a glowing multicolored orb dripping paint in the upper center, and a vibrant pond with lily pads and colorful flowing ribbons on the left. The lower portion shows a green tree-like form with dripping effects against a dark background filled with abstract circles and paint splatters.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic painting featuring a highly detailed grayscale human eye on the right side, a glowing green and yellow orb with colorful paint drips floating above a misty green tree form in the center, a pond with lily pads and flowing colorful ribbons in red yellow and green on the left, abstract black circles and splatters in the dark blue background, vibrant dripping paint effects, dreamlike composition
